name: The Riverglades Report
summary: Captain Nials sends you south with correspondence for Demar Brant at Farholde Keep. A scout reports an enemy force gathering beyond the Wetlands, near a settlement called Farholde.

sections.title: A Scout’s Word
sections.body: Captain Nials has heard that a large enemy force is gathering far south of the Wetlands. A settlement called Farholde may lie there, though its name is only familiar to him. He gives you correspondence for Demar Brant, who leads the detachment at Farholde Keep on the Riverglades’ southeastern coast.

faq.answer: The scout reported a large enemy force gathering far south, beyond the Wetlands.

faq.q: Who is Captain Nials sending me to?
faq.answer: You are to deliver Captain Nials’ correspondence to Demar Brant at Farholde Keep.
Farholde Keep lies along the southeastern coast of the Riverglades.
Captain Nials has heard of a settlement called Farholde near the gathering force.
